notes.summary: Only the payload sent to llama.cpp is compacted. The conversation shown in the UI is never modified or shortened.
notes.trigger: Compaction starts once the prompt is expected to use more than triggerRatio of the context window minus room for the answer.
notes.hybrid: Step 1 trims injected bulk (web results, long attachments), step 2 drops the oldest turns, step 3 asks the loaded model for a summary of the dropped span.
